request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We train and validate an AI model that detects the disease early. Aggregated statistics are not enough: the model needs patient-level records; only model weights and performance metrics leave the secure environment.

definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
